flows.title: Create an empty table with a schema definition
steps: In the Google Cloud console, go to the BigQuery page.
In the left pane, click Explorer.
In the Explorer pane, expand your project, click Datasets, and then select a dataset.
In the Dataset info section, click Create table.
In the Create table pane, under Source, select Empty table in the Create table from list.
Under Destination, select the dataset, enter the name of the table in the Table field, and verify that Table type is set to Native table.
In the Schema section, enter the schema definition. To type it as text, click Edit as text and paste the schema as a JSON array.

flows.title: Export table data to Cloud Storage
steps: In the Google Cloud console, go to the BigQuery page.
In the query editor, enter an EXPORT DATA statement that sets the uri option to the destination path in the bucket, the format option, and whichever other options are needed.
The documentation advises against a LIMIT clause in an EXPORT DATA statement, because it often makes the export job run slowly.
stops: overwriting files already in the destination bucket
